# Report Card

> Building a unit of anything emits its report card. The card is not documentation
> bolted on after — it is the durable artifact the work is born with, the SEED the
> work spawns from, and the honest, graded, two-way-linked account of what the unit
> does and which of its innards do it. A unit shipped without its card is incomplete.

Domain-agnostic. The skin changes (Gherkin for code, circuit-block Given/When/Then
for electronics, request/response for an API); the skeleton never does.

**This skill ships working machinery, not just doctrine.** If a repo has no card
system, install it — don't hand-write prose that evaporates with the conversation.

---

## DO THIS FIRST — is the machinery present?

```bash
ls features/*.feature 2>/dev/null | head -3   # cards exist?
git config core.hooksPath                     # should print .githooks
```

**No cards / no hooks → install, then card.** One command, idempotent, never commits:

```bash
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/install.sh            # current repo, features/
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/install.sh --target /path/to/repo \
    --cards-dir features --title "Foo — Feature Reference"
```

It drops into the repo:

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `features/print-card.py` | cards → `README.md` + printable `dist/` |
| `features/gen-status.py` | cards → `STATUS.md` (the derived test matrix) |
| `features/gen-sessions.py` | Codex transcripts → `SESSIONS.generated.md` |
| `features/cards.conf` | per-repo knobs (title, source extensions, exclusions) |
| `features/TEMPLATE.feature.txt` | the house-style skeleton to copy |
| `features/INDEX.md` | the commit ⇄ card map (the one hand-kept file) |
| `.githooks/pre-commit` + `post-merge` + `report-card-stamp.sh` | the stamp engine |
| `.githooks/pre-commit.local` | repo-local jobs — **yours, never clobbered on reinstall** |
| `core.hooksPath = .githooks` | set for this clone (git won't auto-run committed hooks) |

Then, **every commit onward, with zero effort:** a diff touching a card's `# WATCH:`
symbols stamps a dated RESULT-LOG line into that card *in the same commit*, and a
staged card regenerates `STATUS.md` / `README.md` / `SESSIONS.generated.md` and stages
them too. Mapping is **by symbol, not filename** — touching an unrelated part of a
shared file does not tag every card.

Already installed elsewhere and want the engine refreshed? Re-run `install.sh`; it
overwrites the canonical hooks + generators and keeps `pre-commit.local`, `cards.conf`,
`INDEX.md`, and every card. `--force` to overwrite those too.

## Then: write the card (the same motion as the build)

1. `cp features/TEMPLATE.feature.txt features/<name>.feature` and fill it in.
2. Write `features/<name>.session.md` — the spawning conversation, faithful not
   flattering, with the mandatory **How to get back** block.
3. Back-link the innards: `// REPORT-CARD >> features/<name>.feature` (comment syntax
   of that language).
4. Set the card's `# WATCH:` line to the symbols it owns — that's the hook contract.
5. Enrol it in `features/INDEX.md`.
6. `python3 features/print-card.py --readme` (and `--all` for printable `dist/`).
7. Commit. The hooks do the rest.

**House style, grade ladder, banned anti-patterns:** `reference/house-style.md`.
**Why the format is shaped this way:** `reference/wiki-pattern.md`.

## Just report back to me (works WITHOUT git)

```bash
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/report.sh --target ~/work/foo
```

Regenerates every derived view and prints an honest summary: card count, scenario
count, grades in use, and the three failure modes that otherwise stay silent —
cards with **no `# WATCH:` line** (the hooks can never stamp them), cards whose
grade is written as a **trailing comment** instead of a Gherkin tag (no generator
counts it, so they show as ungraded), and cards with **no `.session.md`** (broken
triad). Finds the card home automatically (`features/`, `cards/`, `docs/cards`).

**Git is optional.** Cards, generators and all derived views work on a plain
folder — `install.sh` detects a non-git target, installs everything except the
hooks, and says so. Only RESULT-LOG *stamping* needs git, because it has to know
which symbols a diff touched. In a non-git folder you run `report.sh` yourself
instead of a commit doing it for you.

## cards.conf keys

| Key | Effect |
|---|---|
| `title` | heading of the generated reference |
| `readme_file` | target for `--readme` (default `README.md`) — **set this if `features/README.md` is hand-written**, or it gets clobbered |
| `source_ext` | extensions recognised as "innards" in a `# cite:` line |
| `meta_prefix` | card-name prefixes grouped as meta/process cards |
| `exclude` | cards kept out of `STATUS.md` (rollups, host-side tooling) |
| `readme_exclude` | cards hidden from the reference entirely (rare) |
| `grade_map` | translate a repo's OWN grade words into canonical tiers, e.g. `@untested-in-renoise:@runtime-untested, @built:@code-verified` — the project keeps its vocabulary AND gets a correct matrix |
| `runtime_label` / `hardware_label` / `status_note` | STATUS.md column labels + note |
| `sessions_file` | session-registry filename (default `SESSIONS.generated.md`) |
| `project_dirs` | extra paths whose Codex transcripts belong to this repo |

## Card dialects — indented banners are legal

Some repos put the banner **inside** the `Feature:` block, indented (Paketti does).
The stamp engine matches `# WATCH:` / `RESULT-LOG >>` at **line start with leading
whitespace allowed**, so both dialects stamp, and the inserted line copies the
marker's own indentation. What is still rejected is a *mid-sentence* mention of the
marker in prose, so a card describing the convention can't opt itself in.

A strict column-0 anchor is what made every Paketti card a silent no-op for months —
hooks installed, running, stamping nothing, no error. If cards aren't being stamped,
run `report.sh` before assuming the hooks are broken.

## Verification commands

```bash
python3 features/print-card.py --readme     # regenerate the feature reference
python3 features/print-card.py --all        # per-card dist/ (pure Gherkin + printable)
python3 features/gen-status.py              # regenerate the test matrix
python3 features/gen-sessions.py            # regenerate the session registry
rtfc features/dist/<name>.card.md           # printable card → RTF clipboard
```

All are dependency-free Apple-native python3, deterministic (no timestamps embedded,
so no commit churn), and resolve the card home from `--cards-dir` → `$REPORT_CARDS_DIR`
→ the script's own directory.

---

## The four properties (every card, every domain)

1. **Verifiable claims** — condition → action → expected result.
   `Given <state>, When <action>, Then <measurable outcome>`.
2. **Linked to the innards** — each claim cites the exact parts that satisfy it
   (proc + line + commit; component refdes + node; file + function).
3. **Honestly graded** — one tag per claim. The grade is the anti-lying mechanism.
   `@designed` `@built` `@build-verified` `@sim-verified` `@runtime-verified`
   `@hw-verified` `@untested` `@hw-untested` `@todo` `@stock`.
   Untested is untested. **Never grade up to look finished.**
4. **Two-way** — the innards carry a greppable back-link to the card, so the wiki is
   bidirectional.

## The triad — three legs, all cross-linked

- **`<name>.feature` (the card)** — the spec: graded verifiable claims, each cited to
  its innards. The *what* + *why-as-grade*.
- **`<name>.session.md`** — the spawning conversation stored beside the card: the
  requests, refinements, corrections, rejected options, the "no I didn't do it"
  admissions. **Faithful, not flattering** — the grade's audit trail. This enables the
  **vibe diff**: across versions you diff the code, the card, AND the dialogue that
  drove each change. A card without its session can spawn the code but not the vibe —
  INCOMPLETE.
  **MANDATORY "How to get back" block** — transcript `file://` path, session ID,
  `Codex --resume <id>`, real date+timestamps pulled from the transcript (never
  fabricated; if unconfirmable, say so). `gen-sessions.py` discovers these repo-wide.
  **MANDATORY bundle, don't just link** — a `file://` link rots the moment the
  `.jsonl` moves. Copy the raw transcript beside the card as
  `<name>.transcript.jsonl` (lossless) plus a readable `<name>.transcript.md`. The
  curated `.session.md` is the audit; the bundled transcript is the source.
- **RESULT block** (card header) — what actually shipped: feature commit(s), the PR if
  any ("direct-push, no PR" when none), card-authoring commit(s), files changed.
  Verify delivery by first-parent ancestry — don't guess; watch duplicate PR numbers
  across forks. The hooks maintain the running RESULT-LOG under it.

Three legs cross-linked ⇒ the wiki is rebuildable straight from git: load one card →
spec + rationale + diff, no re-reading raw source.

## The card is a generative seed (it comes first)

The card opens with a **WHAT THIS CARD SPAWNS** preamble because it spawns three spaces:

- **Codespace** = the file structure — the card's own files plus the innards layout it
  cites. From the card you can scaffold or re-derive the code.
- **Thinkspace** = the reasoning — held in the `.session` (wrong turns included). Also
  what the vibe diff diffs.
- **Areaspace** = the domain boundary — what the unit owns and must NOT touch, so
  re-spawning stays in-bounds. Make it verifiable with a `@stock` "must not break"
  scenario.

`card ⇒ codespace + areaspace`; `session ⇒ thinkspace`.

## Tests → Features → automatic index (never hand-typed)

The whole point is that **code conveys its own verified status** — a behaviour is
written ONCE and every status view derives from it:

1. **Tests ARE the Features.** A verifiable claim lives once as a graded `Scenario`;
   its `@grade` tags **are** its test status.
2. **Features become the index.** The status view is GENERATED from those tags, run
   automatically by the pre-commit hook, committed alongside the card.
3. **So anyone can confirm** with zero manual labour: tested or not, at what level, and
   where it links (card → innards → commits → session).

**Banned anti-pattern:** hand-maintaining a parallel "what's tested" list. If you catch
yourself typing `runtime-verified` into an index, stop — change the card's tag and let
the index regenerate. A derived view cannot disagree with its source; a hand-kept one
drifts and lies. Generated files carry a `DO NOT EDIT — generated` header.

## Relationship to Convey (`~/work/convey`)

**This skill is the DOCTRINE + SKIN SYSTEM + portable tooling. Convey is the larger
ENGINE.** A report card IS a Convey "Underlying Principle" — a `principles/NNNN-slug/`
folder bound to git. The hooks shipped here are Convey's canonical stamp engine, which
is why `install.sh` and `convey hooks install --target .` are interchangeable for the
hook half.

Mapping (full detail in `~/work/convey/docs/DOCTRINE.md`):

- **Emit a card** = `convey new "<title>" --target <folder> --skin <code|circuit|api|media>`.
- **`.feature`** = stage 1 *Describe*; `convey verify` reconciles the declared grade
  with the actual run and **flags optimism** (OPTIMISTIC / UNVERIFIED) — the anti-lying
  mechanism, automated. Where no runner exists it reports UNRUN and keeps the declared
  grade (never fakes a pass).
- **`.session`** = stage 2 *Sessions* + `convey bundle` copies the lossless transcript
  beside the card and fills "How to get back".
- **RESULT** = stage 3 *Done* (git-derived) + stage 5 *Change*.
- **Two-way back-link** = `convey backlink`. **The wiki** = `convey atlas`.

Use Convey where it's installed; use `scripts/install.sh` for any repo (or machine)
where it isn't. The four properties and three legs are identical either way.

## The card is conversable

The `.feature` is compact distilled text with the bundled session as lossless backing,
so you can hand it to a `file-to-text` → LLM reader and *talk to it*:

```bash
card converse <name>           # resolve by name + fm-converse it (Apple on-device LLM)
card converse <name> --full    # converse over the full bundled transcript
card bundle <name>             # copy + render the spawning session beside the card
card list | show | path        # browse cards
```

`card` lives at `~/work/apple/bin/card`. This is *why* the full session must be
bundled, not merely linked — an `fm-converse` session can't follow a dead `file://`
link, but it can read a sibling file.

**The universality corollary.** The card is the *same skeleton for every file format*,
so the underlying principle of ANY file can be read INTO a card: take a `.lua` tool, a
`.mp4`, a `.sch`, a `.pdf`, a `.wav` — distill what it *does* and *why* into graded
Given/When/Then claims cited to its innards, bundle the session that produced it, and
the card becomes the universal, conversable lens on that file.

## Domain skins (same skeleton)

- **Code** — Gherkin `.feature`; scenarios cite `FILE.ext Proc (~line)` + commit; tags
  for status; back-link comment in the source.
- **Electronics / circuits** — one card per block. `Given Vin = 5.0V, When EN goes
  high, Then Vout settles to 3.3V ±2% within 200µs`; cite parts (`U1 AP2112`, divider
  `R3/R4`, `Cout C7`); grade `@sim-verified @hw-untested`. A whole circuit "already
  contains its report card" = each block ships its card; building the circuit is
  composing cards; the top card is the sum of sub-cards; schematic ⇄ card back-link.
  Pairs with `circuitjs1` / `schematic-to-circuitjs`.
- **API / pipeline / signal chain** — claim = request→response / input→artifact /
  source→processed; cite the endpoint/stage/device; grade by where it's verified.

## Backfilling click-back into an existing session file (retrofit)

When a card/session predates the click-back requirement, identify the spawning
transcript by **content, never by guess**:

1. `cd ~/.Codex/projects/<sanitized-cwd>/` (one `.jsonl` per session), or just run
   `gen-sessions.py` which does the discovery repo-wide.
2. Count fixed-string hits per transcript on distinctive strings from the work:
   `for f in *.jsonl; do echo "$(grep -cF -e "PTN0003" -e "Lackluster" "$f")  $f"; done`
   Use `grep -F` / `rg -F` — **never** a regex with `.*` between literals
   (catastrophic-backtracking ban). Confirm with a second distinct probe (65 vs 11 hits
   is decisive; 7 vs 6 is not).
3. Pull the window: first/last `"timestamp"`; convert UTC → local.
4. Add the **How to get back** block, including an "identified by content, not guessed"
   note with the hit count and a "Backfilled: <date>" line.
5. **Honesty:** never fabricate a session ID. If nothing decisively matches, say so.

## The one honest caveat

For domains with no test runner (16-bit TASM assembly, a bench circuit before hardware
exists), the card's claims are *verifiable-in-principle* — a disciplined human/LLM
checklist and session command until automation glue exists. The wiki value (persistent,
compounding, faithful, loadable-as-command, git-rebuildable) holds on day one
regardless of whether the automation is ever written.

---

Global rule: `~/.Codex/AGENTS.md` § "BUILDING ANY UNIT EMITS ITS REPORT CARD".
Reference instance (94 cards, full triads, live hooks): `esaruoho/impulse-tracker`
`features/` — the repo this machinery was isolated from.

local function plsb_scratch_sample()
  if not S.scratch_index then return nil end
  local song = renoise.song()
  local inst = song and song.instruments[S.scratch_index]
  if not inst or #inst.samples < 1 then return nil end

  if not n or n < 1 then return nil end
  local f = math.floor(x / WAVE_W * n) + 1
  if f < 1 then f = 1 elseif f > n then f = n end

local function plsb_sync_loop()
  local smp = plsb_scratch_sample()

  pcall(function()

  renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_OFF, renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_FORWARD,
  renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_REVERSE, renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_PING_PONG,
}

  local smp = plsb_scratch_sample()
  if not smp then return end
  local idx = 1
  for i, m in ipairs(PLSB_LOOP_CYCLE) do if m == smp.loop_mode then idx = i break end end

local function plsb_set_loop_point(which, frame)
  local smp = plsb_scratch_sample()
  if not smp then return end
  local n = smp.sample_buffer.number_of_frames

    if which == "start" then

local function plsb_load_wavs_into_target(wavs, force_new)
  local tgt = plsb_pick_target(force_new)
  if not tgt then return nil end
  local song = renoise.song()
  song.selected_instrument_index = tgt
  pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()      -- template (one placeholder sample)
  tgt = song.selected_instrument_index
  local instr = song.instruments[tgt]
  local n = math.min(#wavs, 120)                    -- Renoise/Paketti drumkit cap
  for i = 1, n do
    if #instr.samples < i then instr:insert_sample_at(i) end
    local smp = instr.samples[i]
    local base = plsb_basename(wavs[i])
    pcall(function() smp.sample_buffer:load_from(wavs[i]) end)
    smp.name = base
    pcall(function() PakettiInjectApplyLoaderSettings(smp) end)
  end
  instr.name = string.format("%02X_", tgt - 1) .. plsb_basename(wavs[1] or "")
  renoise.app():show_status("Loaded " .. n .. " sample(s) into instrument " .. string.format("%02X", tgt - 1))
  return tgt
end

-- The full load: branches by format.
--   plain audio  -> smart target + default template; .wav runs cue-slicing if present
--   rex/rx2/iff/iti/ot/wt/mti/mod -> async expand to wavs, ALL loaded into one instrument
--   pti/sf2/exs  -> async importer builds their own (full-fidelity) instrument; we select it
local function plsb_do_load(path, opts)
  opts = opts or {}
  local jam = opts.jam
  local force_new = opts.force_new
  local ext = plsb_ext(path)

  -- the loop the user shaped on the waveform (a mirror of the scratch sample), so
  -- what you keyjazzed is what gets loaded. nil / Off means "leave the file's own loop".
  local tuned_loop = S.loop

  -- the scratch preview instrument must not be a target candidate or left behind
  plsb_cleanup_scratch()

  if PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then
    local tgt = plsb_pick_target(force_new)
    if not tgt then return end
    local song = renoise.song()
    song.selected_instrument_index = tgt
    pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()
    tgt = song.selected_instrument_index
    local instr = song.instruments[tgt]
    local smp = instr.samples[1]
    if not smp then instr:insert_sample_at(1); smp = instr.samples[1] end
    local base = plsb_basename(path)
    if ext == "wav" then
      -- auto-slices if the wav carries cue chunks, else plain load_from
      pcall(function() PakettiWavCueImportWavWithCuesIntoSample(smp, path) end)
    else
      pcall(function() smp.sample_buffer:load_from(path) end)
    end
    smp.name = base
    instr.name = string.format("%02X_", tgt - 1) .. base
    pcall(function() PakettiInjectApplyLoaderSettings(smp) end)
    -- carry the waveform-tuned loop onto the freshly loaded sample (same audio only,
    -- and never over a cue-sliced load) so the loop you keyjazzed survives the load
    if tuned_loop and tuned_loop.mode and tuned_loop.mode ~= renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_OFF then
      pcall(function()
        local buf = smp.sample_buffer
        if buf.has_sample_data and buf.number_of_frames == tuned_loop.frames
          and #smp.slice_markers == 0 then
          local n = buf.number_of_frames
          local a = math.max(1, math.min(n - 1, tuned_loop.start))
          local b = math.max(a + 1, math.min(n, tuned_loop.stop))
          smp.loop_mode = renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_OFF
          smp.loop_start = 1
          smp.loop_end = b
          smp.loop_start = a
          smp.loop_mode = tuned_loop.mode
        end
      end)
    end
    renoise.app():show_status("Loaded " .. base .. " into instrument " .. string.format("%02X", tgt - 1))
    plsb_finalize(tgt, jam)
  else
    -- async handles pti/sf2/exs (self-import) AND harvests rex/rx2/iff/iti/ot/wt/mti/mod
    PakettiExpandLoadableFilesAsync({ path }, function(expanded, temps, failures)
      local tgt
      if expanded and #expanded > 0 then
        tgt = plsb_load_wavs_into_target(expanded, force_new)
      else
        -- pti/sf2/exs loaded straight into their own instrument (already selected)
        tgt = renoise.song().selected_instrument_index
      end
      pcall(function() PakettiExpandLoadableCleanup(temps) end)
      plsb_finalize(tgt, jam)
    end)
  end
end

local function plsb_confirm_now()
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  if not (e and e.kind == "file") then
    plsb_close_now(true)
    return
  end
  local path = e.path
  plsb_all_notes_off()
  plsb_close_now(false)          -- close our dialog first; loaders may show their own
  plsb_do_load(path, { force_new = false, jam = false })
end

name: report-card
description: Emit a report card for any built unit — code feature, circuit block, subsystem, API, pipeline, signal chain — AND install the machinery that keeps it alive. A report card is the triad {.feature spec + .session conversation + RESULT (commits/PR/files)} born WITH the thing, graded honestly, linked both ways to its innards, and acting as the seed the work spawns from. Ships working tooling: an installer that drops card generators + self-stamping git hooks into any repo, so cards regenerate their own README/STATUS and stamp their own RESULT-LOGs. Use when building/shipping a unit that should carry its own durable, graded, session-backed description, or when a repo has no card system yet. Triggers on "report card", "report on this", "make a card for this", "card this feature/circuit", "whitelabel the card", "vibe diff", or finishing a unit of work that should self-document.
domain: cross-domain
version: 2.0.0
tags: [report-card, gherkin, feature, session, vibe-diff, wiki, traceability, electronics, circuits, honesty, seed, git-hooks, tooling]
---

# Report Card

> Building a unit of anything emits its report card. The card is not documentation
> bolted on after — it is the durable artifact the work is born with, the SEED the
> work spawns from, and the honest, graded, two-way-linked account of what the unit
> does and which of its innards do it. A unit shipped without its card is incomplete.

Domain-agnostic. The skin changes (Gherkin for code, circuit-block Given/When/Then
for electronics, request/response for an API); the skeleton never does.

**This skill ships working machinery, not just doctrine.** If a repo has no card
system, install it — don't hand-write prose that evaporates with the conversation.

---

## DO THIS FIRST — is the machinery present?

```bash
ls features/*.feature 2>/dev/null | head -3   # cards exist?
git config core.hooksPath                     # should print .githooks
```

**No cards / no hooks → install, then card.** One command, idempotent, never commits:

```bash
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/install.sh            # current repo, features/
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/install.sh --target /path/to/repo \
    --cards-dir features --title "Foo — Feature Reference"
```

It drops into the repo:

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `features/print-card.py` | cards → `README.md` + printable `dist/` |
| `features/gen-status.py` | cards → `STATUS.md` (the derived test matrix) |
| `features/gen-sessions.py` | Codex tran…266 tokens truncated…t.local`, `cards.conf`,
`INDEX.md`, and every card. `--force` to overwrite those too.

## Then: write the card (the same motion as the build)

1. `cp features/TEMPLATE.feature.txt features/<name>.feature` and fill it in.
2. Write `features/<name>.session.md` — the spawning conversation, faithful not
   flattering, with the mandatory **How to get back** block.
3. Back-link the innards: `// REPORT-CARD >> features/<name>.feature` (comment syntax
   of that language).
4. Set the card's `# WATCH:` line to the symbols it owns — that's the hook contract.
5. Enrol it in `features/INDEX.md`.
6. `python3 features/print-card.py --readme` (and `--all` for printable `dist/`).
7. Commit. The hooks do the rest.

**House style, grade ladder, banned anti-patterns:** `reference/house-style.md`.
**Why the format is shaped this way:** `reference/wiki-pattern.md`.

## Just report back to me (works WITHOUT git)

```bash
~/.Codex/skills/report-card/scripts/report.sh --target ~/work/foo
```

Regenerates every derived view and prints an honest summary: card count, scenario
count, grades in use, and the three failure modes that otherwise stay silent —
cards with **no `# WATCH:` line** (the hooks can never stamp them), cards whose
grade is written as a **trailing comment** instead of a Gherkin tag (no generator
counts it, so they show as ungraded), and cards with **no `.session.md`** (broken
triad). Finds the card home automatically (`features/`, `cards/`, `docs/cards`).

**Git is optional.** Cards, generators and all derived views work on a plain
folder — `install.sh` detects a non-git target, installs everything except the
hooks, and says so. Only RESULT-LOG *stamping* needs git, because it has to know
which symbols a diff touched. In a non-git folder you run `report.sh` yourself
instead of a commit doing it for you.

## cards.conf keys

| Key | Effect |
|---|---|
| `title` | heading of the generated reference |
| `readme_file` | target for `--readme` (default `README.md`) — **set this if `features/README.md` is hand-written**, or it gets clobbered |
| `source_ext` | extensions recognised as "innards" in a `# cite:` line |
| `meta_prefix` | card-name prefixes grouped as meta/process cards |
| `exclude` | cards kept out of `STATUS.md` (rollups, host-side tooling) |
| `readme_exclude` | cards hidden from the reference entirely (rare) |
| `grade_map` | translate a repo's OWN grade words into canonical tiers, e.g. `@untested-in-renoise:@runtime-untested, @built:@code-verified` — the project keeps its vocabulary AND gets a correct matrix |
| `runtime_label` / `hardware_label` / `status_note` | STATUS.md column labels + note |
| `sessions_file` | session-registry filename (default `SESSIONS.generated.md`) |
| `project_dirs` | extra paths whose Codex transcripts belong to this repo |

## Card dialects — indented banners are legal

Some repos put the banner **inside** the `Feature:` block, indented (Paketti does).
The stamp engine matches `# WATCH:` / `RESULT-LOG >>` at **line start with leading
whitespace allowed**, so both dialects stamp, and the inserted line copies the
marker's own indentation. What is still rejected is a *mid-sentence* mention of the
marker in prose, so a card describing the convention can't opt itself in.

A strict column-0 anchor is what made every Paketti card a silent no-op for months —
hooks installed, running, stamping nothing, no error. If cards aren't being stamped,
run `report.sh` before assuming the hooks are broken.

## Verification commands

```bash
python3 features/print-card.py --readme     # regenerate the feature reference
python3 features/print-card.py --all        # per-card dist/ (pure Gherkin + printable)
python3 features/gen-status.py              # regenerate the test matrix
python3 features/gen-sessions.py            # regenerate the session registry
rtfc features/dist/<name>.card.md           # printable card → RTF clipboard
```

All are dependency-free Apple-native python3, deterministic (no timestamps embedded,
so no commit churn), and resolve the card home from `--cards-dir` → `$REPORT_CARDS_DIR`
→ the script's own directory.

---

## The four properties (every card, every domain)

1. **Verifiable claims** — condition → action → expected result.
   `Given <state>, When <action>, Then <measurable outcome>`.
2. **Linked to the innards** — each claim cites the exact parts that satisfy it
   (proc + line + commit; component refdes + node; file + function).
3. **Honestly graded** — one tag per claim. The grade is the anti-lying mechanism.
   `@designed` `@built` `@build-verified` `@sim-verified` `@runtime-verified`
   `@hw-verified` `@untested` `@hw-untested` `@todo` `@stock`.
   Untested is untested. **Never grade up to look finished.**
4. **Two-way** — the innards carry a greppable back-link to the card, so the wiki is
   bidirectional.

## The triad — three legs, all cross-linked

- **`<name>.feature` (the card)** — the spec: graded verifiable claims, each cited to
  its innards. The *what* + *why-as-grade*.
- **`<name>.session.md`** — the spawning conversation stored beside the card: the
  requests, refinements, corrections, rejected options, the "no I didn't do it"
  admissions. **Faithful, not flattering** — the grade's audit trail. This enables the
  **vibe diff**: across versions you diff the code, the card, AND the dialogue that
  drove each change. A card without its session can spawn the code but not the vibe —
  INCOMPLETE.
  **MANDATORY "How to get back" block** — transcript `file://` path, session ID,
  `Codex --resume <id>`, real date+timestamps pulled from the transcript (never
  fabricated; if unconfirmable, say so). `gen-sessions.py` discovers these repo-wide.
  **MANDATORY bundle, don't just link** — a `file://` link rots the moment the
  `.jsonl` moves. Copy the raw transcript beside the card as
  `<name>.transcript.jsonl` (lossless) plus a readable `<name>.transcript.md`. The
  curated `.session.md` is the audit; the bundled transcript is the source.
- **RESULT block** (card header) — what actually shipped: feature commit(s), the PR if
  any ("direct-push, no PR" when none), card-authoring commit(s), files changed.
  Verify delivery by first-parent ancestry — don't guess; watch duplicate PR numbers
  across forks. The hooks maintain the running RESULT-LOG under it.

Three legs cross-linked ⇒ the wiki is rebuildable straight from git: load one card →
spec + rationale + diff, no re-reading raw source.

## The card is a generative seed (it comes first)

The card opens with a **WHAT THIS CARD SPAWNS** preamble because it spawns three spaces:

- **Codespace** = the file structure — the card's own files plus the innards layout it
  cites. From the card you can scaffold or re-derive the code.
- **Thinkspace** = the reasoning — held in the `.session` (wrong turns included). Also
  what the vibe diff diffs.
- **Areaspace** = the domain boundary — what the unit owns and must NOT touch, so
  re-spawning stays in-bounds. Make it verifiable with a `@stock` "must not break"
  scenario.

`card ⇒ codespace + areaspace`; `session ⇒ thinkspace`.

## Tests → Features → automatic index (never hand-typed)

The whole point is that **code conveys its own verified status** — a behaviour is
written ONCE and every status view derives from it:

1. **Tests ARE the Features.** A verifiable claim lives once as a graded `Scenario`;
   its `@grade` tags **are** its test status.
2. **Features become the index.** The status view is GENERATED from those tags, run
   automatically by the pre-commit hook, committed alongside the card.
3. **So anyone can confirm** with zero manual labour: tested or not, at what level, and
   where it links (card → innards → commits → session).

**Banned anti-pattern:** hand-maintaining a parallel "what's tested" list. If you catch
yourself typing `runtime-verified` into an index, stop — change the card's tag and let
the index regenerate. A derived view cannot disagree with its source; a hand-kept one
drifts and lies. Generated files carry a `DO NOT EDIT — generated` header.

## Relationship to Convey (`~/work/convey`)

**This skill is the DOCTRINE + SKIN SYSTEM + portable tooling. Convey is the larger
ENGINE.** A report card IS a Convey "Underlying Principle" — a `principles/NNNN-slug/`
folder bound to git. The hooks shipped here are Convey's canonical stamp engine, which
is why `install.sh` and `convey hooks install --target .` are interchangeable for the
hook half.

Mapping (full detail in `~/work/convey/docs/DOCTRINE.md`):

- **Emit a card** = `convey new "<title>" --target <folder> --skin <code|circuit|api|media>`.
- **`.feature`** = stage 1 *Describe*; `convey verify` reconciles the declared grade
  with the actual run and **flags optimism** (OPTIMISTIC / UNVERIFIED) — the anti-lying
  mechanism, automated. Where no runner exists it reports UNRUN and keeps the declared
  grade (never fakes a pass).
- **`.session`** = stage 2 *Sessions* + `convey bundle` copies the lossless transcript
  beside the card and fills "How to get back".
- **RESULT** = stage 3 *Done* (git-derived) + stage 5 *Change*.
- **Two-way back-link** = `convey backlink`. **The wiki** = `convey atlas`.

Use Convey where it's installed; use `scripts/install.sh` for any repo (or machine)
where it isn't. The four properties and three legs are identical either way.

## The card is conversable

The `.feature` is compact distilled text with the bundled session as lossless backing,
so you can hand it to a `file-to-text` → LLM reader and *talk to it*:

```bash
card converse <name>           # resolve by name + fm-converse it (Apple on-device LLM)
card converse <name> --full    # converse over the full bundled transcript
card bundle <name>             # copy + render the spawning session beside the card
card list | show | path        # browse cards
```

`card` lives at `~/work/apple/bin/card`. This is *why* the full session must be
bundled, not merely linked — an `fm-converse` session can't follow a dead `file://`
link, but it can read a sibling file.

**The universality corollary.** The card is the *same skeleton for every file format*,
so the underlying principle of ANY file can be read INTO a card: take a `.lua` tool, a
`.mp4`, a `.sch`, a `.pdf`, a `.wav` — distill what it *does* and *why* into graded
Given/When/Then claims cited to its innards, bundle the session that produced it, and
the card becomes the universal, conversable lens on that file.

## Domain skins (same skeleton)

- **Code** — Gherkin `.feature`; scenarios cite `FILE.ext Proc (~line)` + commit; tags
  for status; back-link comment in the source.
- **Electronics / circuits** — one card per block. `Given Vin = 5.0V, When EN goes
  high, Then Vout settles to 3.3V ±2% within 200µs`; cite parts (`U1 AP2112`, divider
  `R3/R4`, `Cout C7`); grade `@sim-verified @hw-untested`. A whole circuit "already
  contains its report card" = each block ships its card; building the circuit is
  composing cards; the top card is the sum of sub-cards; schematic ⇄ card back-link.
  Pairs with `circuitjs1` / `schematic-to-circuitjs`.
- **API / pipeline / signal chain** — claim = request→response / input→artifact /
  source→processed; cite the endpoint/stage/device; grade by where it's verified.

## Backfilling click-back into an existing session file (retrofit)

When a card/session predates the click-back requirement, identify the spawning
transcript by **content, never by guess**:

1. `cd ~/.Codex/projects/<sanitized-cwd>/` (one `.jsonl` per session), or just run
   `gen-sessions.py` which does the discovery repo-wide.
2. Count fixed-string hits per transcript on distinctive strings from the work:
   `for f in *.jsonl; do echo "$(grep -cF -e "PTN0003" -e "Lackluster" "$f")  $f"; done`
   Use `grep -F` / `rg -F` — **never** a regex with `.*` between literals
   (catastrophic-backtracking ban). Confirm with a second distinct probe (65 vs 11 hits
   is decisive; 7 vs 6 is not).
3. Pull the window: first/last `"timestamp"`; convert UTC → local.
4. Add the **How to get back** block, including an "identified by content, not guessed"
   note with the hit count and a "Backfilled: <date>" line.
5. **Honesty:** never fabricate a session ID. If nothing decisively matches, say so.

## The one honest caveat

For domains with no test runner (16-bit TASM assembly, a bench circuit before hardware
exists), the card's claims are *verifiable-in-principle* — a disciplined human/LLM
checklist and session command until automation glue exists. The wiki value (persistent,
compounding, faithful, loadable-as-command, git-rebuildable) holds on day one
regardless of whether the automation is ever written.

---

Global rule: `~/.Codex/AGENTS.md` § "BUILDING ANY UNIT EMITS ITS REPORT CARD".
Reference instance (94 cards, full triads, live hooks): `esaruoho/impulse-tracker`
`features/` — the repo this machinery was isolated from.

local function plsb_wave_mouse(ev)
  if S.pending_action then return end
  local x = ev.position.x
  if ev.type == "down" then
    if ev.button ~= "left" then return end
    S.drag_moved = false
    local grabbed
    if S.loop and S.loop.mode ~= renoise.Sample.LOOP_MODE_OFF then
      local xs = (S.loop.start - 1) / math.max(1, S.loop.frames) * WAVE_W
      local xe = (S.loop.stop - 1) / math.max(1, S.loop.frames) * WAVE_W
      if math.abs(x - xs) <= 6 then grabbed = "start"
      elseif math.abs(x - xe) <= 6 then grabbed = "end" end
    end
    if grabbed then
      S.drag = grabbed
    else
      S.drag = "select"
      local f = plsb_frame_at_x(x)
      S.sel_anchor = f
      S.sel_range = f and { f, f } or nil
      if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
    end
  elseif ev.type == "move" or ev.type == "drag" then
    if not S.drag then return end
    S.drag_moved = true
    local f = plsb_frame_at_x(x)
    if not f then return end
    if S.drag == "start" or S.drag == "end" then
      plsb_set_loop_point(S.drag, f)
    elseif S.drag == "select" then
      S.sel_range = { S.sel_anchor or f, f }
      if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
    end
  elseif ev.type == "up" then
    local was = S.drag
    S.drag = nil
    if was == "select" and not S.drag_moved then
      -- a plain click (no drag) = play from that point
      S.sel_range = nil
      local f = plsb_frame_at_x(x)
      local n = (S.loop and S.loop.frames) or 1
      plsb_play_from(f and ((f - 1) / math.max(1, n)) or 0)
    end
  end
end

-- Keep the originating window alive until native keyboard dispatch has returned.
-- Freeze the selection while queued and remove the repeating timer BEFORE work.
local function plsb_defer_action(action)
  if S.pending_action then return end
  local dialog = S.dialog
  if not (dialog and dialog.visible) then return end
  local callback
  callback = function()
    plsb_cancel_pending_action()
    if S.dialog ~= dialog or not dialog.visible then return end
    local ok, err = pcall(action)
    if not ok then
      renoise.app():show_error("Paketti Load Sample: " .. tostring(err))
    end
  end
  S.pending_action = callback
  renoise.tool():add_timer(callback, 50)
end

-- Song is being torn down (New/Load Song). A custom dialog + its key_handler and
-- the octave observer would dangle and crash Renoise's keyboard dispatch
-- (TWeakRefOwner / SIGSEGV), so drop everything WITHOUT touching renoise.song()
-- (its observables die with it; the scratch instrument goes with the song too).
local function plsb_on_document_release()
  plsb_cancel_pending_action()
  S.octave_notifier = nil      -- its observable dies with the song; don't remove
  S.active_notes = {}
  S.scratch_index = nil
  S.loaded_path = nil
  S.preview_ok = false
  if S.dialog then pcall(function() if S.dialog.visible then S.dialog:close() end end) end
  S.dialog = nil
  plsb_remove_doc_notifier()
end

local function plsb_persist_selection()
  if not preferences then return end
  if preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastDir then
    preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastDir.value = S.current_dir or ""
  end
  if preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastFile then
    local e = S.entries[S.selected]
    preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastFile.value = (e and e.name) or ""
  end
  preferences:save_as("preferences.xml")
end

local function plsb_close_now(cancelled)
  plsb_persist_selection()   -- remember folder + highlighted file for next open
  plsb_remove_octave_notifier()
  plsb_remove_doc_notifier()
  plsb_all_notes_off()
  -- restore the Edit Mode state we may have turned off on open (the jam path
  -- re-enables it afterwards in plsb_finalize)
  if S.prev_edit_mode ~= nil then
    pcall(function() renoise.song().transport.edit_mode = S.prev_edit_mode end)
    S.prev_edit_mode = nil
  end
  if cancelled then plsb_cleanup_scratch() end
  if S.dialog and S.dialog.visible then
    S.dialog:close()
  end
  S.dialog = nil
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Close(cancelled)

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Confirm()

-- load a single file into its own pakettified target slot; returns true on success.
-- Used by the Shift+Enter "load every sample in this folder" path. Native audio only
-- here (load pti/sf2/mod/etc one at a time with Enter, which uses the async expander).
local function plsb_load_path(path)
  local ext = plsb_ext(path)
  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then return false end
  local song = renoise.song()
  local tgt = plsb_pick_target(false)
  if not tgt then return false end
  song.selected_instrument_index = tgt
  pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()
  tgt = song.selected_instrument_index
  local instr = song.instruments[tgt]
  local smp = instr.samples[1]
  if not smp then instr:insert_sample_at(1); smp = instr.samples[1] end
  local base = plsb_basename(path)
  if ext == "wav" then
    pcall(function() PakettiWavCueImportWavWithCuesIntoSample(smp, path) end)
  else
    pcall(function() smp.sample_buffer:load_from(path) end)
  end
  if not smp.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then return false end
  smp.name = base
  instr.name = string.format("%02X_", tgt - 1) .. base
  pcall(function() PakettiInjectApplyLoaderSettings(smp) end)
  return true
end

-- BATCH OT TO WAV+CUE EXPORT
-- Converts a folder of .ot files to WAV files with CUE files
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local separator = package.config:sub(1,1)  -- Gets \ for Windows, / for Unix

  local path = e.path
  plsb_all_notes_off()
  plsb_close_now(false)
  plsb_do_load(path, { force_new = false, jam = true })
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Confirm()
  plsb_defer_action(plsb_confirm_now)
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_ConfirmJam()
  plsb_defer_action(plsb_confirm_jam_now)
end

-- load a single file into its own pakettified target slot; returns true on success.
-- Used by the Shift+Enter "load every sample in this folder" path. Native audio only
-- here (load pti/sf2/mod/etc one at a time with Enter, which uses the async expander).
local function plsb_load_path(path)
  local ext = plsb_ext(path)
  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then return false end
  local song = renoise.song()
  local tgt = plsb_pick_target(false)
  if not tgt then return false end
  song.selected_instrument_index = tgt
  pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()
  tgt = song.selected_instrument_index
  local instr = song.instruments[tgt]
  local smp = instr.samples[1]
  if not smp then instr:insert_sample_at(1); smp = instr.samples[1] end
  local base = plsb_basename(path)
  if ext == "wav" then
    pcall(function() PakettiWavCueImportWavWithCuesIntoSample(smp, path) end)
  else
    pcall(function() smp.sample_buffer:load_from(path) end)
  end
  if not smp.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then return false end
  smp.name = base
  instr.name = string.format("%02X_", tgt - 1) .. base
  pcall(function() PakettiInjectApplyLoaderSettings(smp) end)
  return true
end

-- Check if we're on instrument 00 (index 1) and if it's empty
  local current_index = song.selected_instrument_index
  local current_instrument = song.selected_instrument
  local use_existing_instrument = false
  
  if current_index == 1 and PakettiWavCueIsInstrumentEmpty(current_instrument) then
    print("PakettiWavCueExtract: Using existing empty instrument 00 instead of creating new instrument")
    use_existing_instrument = true
  else
    -- Create a new instrument
    if not safeInsertInstrumentAt(song, current_index + 1) then return end
    song.selected_instrument_index = current_index + 1
    print("PakettiWavCueExtract: Inserted new instrument at index: " .. song.selected_instrument_index)
  end

  -- Inject the default Paketti instrument configuration if available
  if pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader then
    pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()
    if use_existing_instrument then
      print("PakettiWavCueExtract: Injected Paketti default instrument configuration for existing instrument 00")
    else
      print("PakettiWavCueExtract: Injected Paketti default instrument configuration for new instrument")
    end
  else
    print("PakettiWavCueExtract: pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader not found - skipping default configuration")
  end

  local inst = song.selected_instrument
  
  -- Ensure there's at least one sample in the instrument
  if #inst.samples == 0 then
    inst:insert_sample_at(1)
    print("PakettiWavCueExtract: Created first sample slot")
  end
  
  -- Ensure we're working with the first sample slot
  song.selected_sample_index = 1
  local sample = song.selected_sample
  
  PakettiWavCueImportWavWithCuesIntoSample(sample, file)

  -- Options > "Sliced Imports Also Go Into Amigo": build a second
  -- instrument holding Amigo with the same audio and the same cue points.
  -- The Renoise instrument this just filled is left untouched.
  if PakettiAmigoHandleSlicedImport then
    PakettiAmigoHandleSlicedImport(song.selected_instrument_index, "WAV+CUE")
  end
end

-- BATCH OT TO WAV+CUE EXPORT
-- Converts a folder of .ot files to WAV files with CUE files
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local separator = package.config:sub(1,1)  -- Gets \ for Windows, / for Unix

  local path = e.path
  plsb_all_notes_off()
  plsb_close_now(false)
  plsb_do_load(path, { force_new = false, jam = true })
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Confirm()
  plsb_defer_action(plsb_confirm_now)
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_ConfirmJam()
  plsb_defer_action(plsb_confirm_jam_now)
end

-- load a single file into its own pakettified target slot; returns true on success.
-- Used by the Shift+Enter "load every sample in this folder" path. Native audio only
-- here (load pti/sf2/mod/etc one at a time with Enter, which uses the async expander).
local function plsb_load_path(path)
  local ext = plsb_ext(path)
  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then return false end
  local song = renoise.song()
  local tgt = plsb_pick_target(false)
  if not tgt then return false end
  song.selected_instrument_index = tgt
  pakettiPreferencesDefaultInstrumentLoader()
  tgt = song.selected_instrument_index
  local instr = song.instruments[tgt]
  local smp = instr.samples[1]
  if not smp then instr:insert_sample_at(1); smp = instr.samples[1] end
  local base = plsb_basename(path)
  if ext == "wav" then
    pcall(function() PakettiWavCueImportWavWithCuesIntoSample(smp, path) end)
  else
    pcall(function() smp.sample_buffer:load_from(path) end)
  end
  if not smp.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then return false end
  smp.name = base
  instr.name = string.format("%02X_", tgt - 1) .. base
  pcall(function() PakettiInjectApplyLoaderSettings(smp) end)
  return true
end

-- load the highlighted file into the scratch instrument for preview
local function plsb_preview_selected()
  S.preview_ok = false
  S.peaks = nil
  S.meta = {}
  S.loop = nil
  S.sel_range = nil
  S.drag = nil
  if plsb_clear_preview_slices then plsb_clear_preview_slices() end
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  if not e or e.kind ~= "file" then S.loaded_path = nil; return end
  S.loaded_path = e.path
  local ext = plsb_ext(e.name)

  -- file-level metadata (best effort)
  local meta = { name = e.name, format = plsb_format_for_ext(ext), size = nil, date = nil }
  local ok_stat, st = pcall(function() return io.stat(e.path) end)
  if ok_stat and st then
    if st.size then meta.size = st.size end
    if st.mtime then
      meta.date = os.date("%B %d, %Y", st.mtime)
      meta.time = os.date("%I:%M%p", st.mtime)
    end
  end
  S.meta = meta

  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then
    -- non-native: list + confirm-load supported, but no live preview/waveform
    S.meta.note = "Preview N/A - press Enter to load"
    if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
    return
  end

  local idx = plsb_ensure_scratch()
  local song = renoise.song()
  local sample = song.instruments[idx].samples[1]
  local loaded = false
  pcall(function() loaded = sample.sample_buffer:load_from(e.path) end)
  if loaded and sample.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then
    local buf = sample.sample_buffer
    sample.name = e.name
    S.preview_ok = true
    S.meta.sample_rate = buf.sample_rate
    S.meta.bit_depth = buf.bit_depth
    S.meta.channels = buf.number_of_channels
    S.meta.frames = buf.number_of_frames
    S.meta.loop_mode = plsb_loop_mode_name(sample.loop_mode)
    S.meta.loop_start = sample.loop_start
    S.meta.loop_end = sample.loop_end
    S.loop = { mode = sample.loop_mode, start = sample.loop_start,
               stop = sample.loop_end, frames = buf.number_of_frames }
    S.peaks = plsb_compute_peaks(buf, 300)
  else
    S.meta.note = "Could not decode for preview"
  end
  if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
end

-- directory listing -----------------------------------------------------------
local function plsb_adjust_scroll()
  if S.selected < S.scroll + 1 then S.scroll = S.selected - 1 end
  if S.selected > S.scroll + VISIBLE_ROWS then S.scroll = S.selected - VISIBLE_ROWS end
  if S.scroll < 0 then S.scroll = 0 end
end

local function plsb_rebuild_entries(select_name)
  S.entries = {}
  local dir = S.current_dir

  -- synthetic "all drives" level (Windows): list each mounted drive, no up-dir
  if dir == PLSB_DRIVE_ROOT then
    for _, d in ipairs(plsb_list_drives()) do
      S.entries[#S.entries + 1] = { kind = "dir", name = d.label, path = d.path }
    end
  else
    -- the find filter (nil = show everything). Folders are only filtered when the
    -- query is active, so you can still navigate; the updir "." always stays.
    local filt = plsb_find_parse(S.find_query)
-- the human-readable metadata block (plain text, not canvas font)
local function plsb_meta_string()
  local m = S.meta
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  local oct = (renoise.song() and renoise.song().transport.octave) or 0
  if not e then return "No file selected\n\nKeyjazz octave: " .. oct end
  if e.kind ~= "file" then
    return (e.kind == "updir" and ".. (parent folder)" or ("Folder: " .. e.name))
      .. "\n\nEnter to open\n\nKeyjazz octave: " .. oct
  end
  local lines = {}
  lines[#lines + 1] = "Filename:    " .. (m.name or "-")

local function plsb_key_handler(dialog, key)
  if S.pending_action then return nil end
  local name = key.name

  -- key releases: stop keyjazz notes
  if key.state == "released" then
    if name and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
      plsb_note_off(name)
      return nil
    end
    return key
  end

  -- navigation + actions (not key-repeat sensitive except arrows)
  if name == "esc" then
    PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Close(true)
    return nil
  elseif name == "rshift" then
    -- Right-Shift = load into a NEW instrument, close, Edit Mode + Follow Pattern on,
    -- and jump to the Pattern Editor ready to jam
    if not key.repeated then PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_ConfirmJam() end
    return nil
  elseif name == "return" then
    if not key.repeated then
      local e = S.entries[S.selected]
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift", 1, true) and e and e.kind == "dir" then
        plsb_defer_action(plsb_load_folder_now)
      else
        plsb_activate_entry()
      end
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "up" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Up jumps to the top
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(1) else plsb_move(-1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "down" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Down jumps to the bottom
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(#S.entries) else plsb_move(1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "prior" then       -- Page Up
    plsb_move(-VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "next" then        -- Page Down
    plsb_move(VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "left" or name == "back" then
    plsb_go_up()
    return nil
  elseif name == "right" then
    local e = S.entries[S.selected]
    if e and e.kind == "updir" then
      plsb_go_up()
    elseif e and e.kind == "dir" then
      plsb_enter_dir(e.path)
      plsb_refresh()
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "<" or name == "less" then
    plsb_shift_octave(-1); return nil
  elseif name == ">" or name == "greater" then
    plsb_shift_octave(1); return nil
  end

  -- F1-F12 folder presets: Fn recalls, Shift+Fn stores the current folder
  local fn = name and name:match("^f(%d+)$")
  if fn then
    local n = tonumber(fn)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 12 then
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift") then
        plsb_set_preset(n, S.current_dir)
        renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: stored folder preset F" .. n .. " = " .. (S.current_dir or ""))

        local presets = plsb_get_presets()
        local p = presets[n]
        if p and p ~= "" and io.exists(p) then
          plsb_enter_dir(p)
          plsb_refresh()
        else
          renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: folder preset F" .. n .. " is empty (Shift+F" .. n .. " to store current folder)")
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
  end

  -- Modified piano keys belong to Renoise's global shortcuts.
  if (not key.modifiers or key.modifiers == "") and name
    and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
    if not key.repeated then plsb_note_on(name) end
    return nil
  end

  -- Octave controls and the opening shortcut must reach Renoise. Confirmation
  -- queues a timer, so forwarding does not destroy this window during dispatch.
  return key
end

-- load the highlighted file into the scratch instrument for preview
local function plsb_preview_selected()
  S.preview_ok = false
  S.peaks = nil
  S.meta = {}
  S.loop = nil
  S.sel_range = nil
  S.drag = nil
  if plsb_clear_preview_slices then plsb_clear_preview_slices() end
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  if not e or e.kind ~= "file" then S.loaded_path = nil; return end
  S.loaded_path = e.path
  local ext = plsb_ext(e.name)

  -- file-level metadata (best effort)
  local meta = { name = e.name, format = plsb_format_for_ext(ext), size = nil, date = nil }
  local ok_stat, st = pcall(function() return io.stat(e.path) end)
  if ok_stat and st then
    if st.size then meta.size = st.size end
    if st.mtime then
      meta.date = os.date("%B %d, %Y", st.mtime)
      meta.time = os.date("%I:%M%p", st.mtime)
    end
  end
  S.meta = meta

  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then
    -- non-native: list + confirm-load supported, but no live preview/waveform
    S.meta.note = "Preview N/A - press Enter to load"
    if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
    return
  end

  local idx = plsb_ensure_scratch()
  local song = renoise.song()
  local sample = song.instruments[idx].samples[1]
  local loaded = false
  pcall(function() loaded = sample.sample_buffer:load_from(e.path) end)
  if loaded and sample.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then
    local buf = sample.sample_buffer
    sample.name = e.name
    S.preview_ok = true
    S.meta.sample_rate = buf.sample_rate
    S.meta.bit_depth = buf.bit_depth
    S.meta.channels = buf.number_of_channels
    S.meta.frames = buf.number_of_frames
    S.meta.loop_mode = plsb_loop_mode_name(sample.loop_mode)
    S.meta.loop_start = sample.loop_start
    S.meta.loop_end = sample.loop_end
    S.loop = { mode = sample.loop_mode, start = sample.loop_start,
               stop = sample.loop_end, frames = buf.number_of_frames }
    S.peaks = plsb_compute_peaks(buf, 300)
  else
    S.meta.note = "Could not decode for preview"
  end
  if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
end

-- load the highlighted file into the scratch instrument for preview
local function plsb_preview_selected()
  S.preview_ok = false
  S.peaks = nil
  S.meta = {}
  S.loop = nil
  S.sel_range = nil
  S.drag = nil
  if plsb_clear_preview_slices then plsb_clear_preview_slices() end
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  if not e or e.kind ~= "file" then S.loaded_path = nil; return end
  S.loaded_path = e.path
  local ext = plsb_ext(e.name)

  -- file-level metadata (best effort)
  local meta = { name = e.name, format = plsb_format_for_ext(ext), size = nil, date = nil }
  local ok_stat, st = pcall(function() return io.stat(e.path) end)
  if ok_stat and st then
    if st.size then meta.size = st.size end
    if st.mtime then
      meta.date = os.date("%B %d, %Y", st.mtime)
      meta.time = os.date("%I:%M%p", st.mtime)
    end
  end
  S.meta = meta

  if not PLSB_NATIVE[ext] then
    -- non-native: list + confirm-load supported, but no live preview/waveform
    S.meta.note = "Preview N/A - press Enter to load"
    if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
    return
  end

  local idx = plsb_ensure_scratch()
  local song = renoise.song()
  local sample = song.instruments[idx].samples[1]
  local loaded = false
  pcall(function() loaded = sample.sample_buffer:load_from(e.path) end)
  if loaded and sample.sample_buffer.has_sample_data then
    local buf = sample.sample_buffer
    sample.name = e.name
    S.preview_ok = true
    S.meta.sample_rate = buf.sample_rate
    S.meta.bit_depth = buf.bit_depth
    S.meta.channels = buf.number_of_channels
    S.meta.frames = buf.number_of_frames
    S.meta.loop_mode = plsb_loop_mode_name(sample.loop_mode)
    S.meta.loop_start = sample.loop_start
    S.meta.loop_end = sample.loop_end
    S.loop = { mode = sample.loop_mode, start = sample.loop_start,
               stop = sample.loop_end, frames = buf.number_of_frames }
    S.peaks = plsb_compute_peaks(buf, 300)
  else
    S.meta.note = "Could not decode for preview"
  end
  if plsb_refresh then plsb_refresh() end
end

local function plsb_adjust_scroll()
  if S.selected < S.scroll + 1 then S.scroll = S.selected - 1 end
  if S.selected > S.scroll + VISIBLE_ROWS then S.scroll = S.selected - VISIBLE_ROWS end
  if S.scroll < 0 then S.scroll = 0 end
end

local function plsb_key_handler(dialog, key)
  if S.pending_action then return nil end
  local name = key.name

  -- key releases: stop keyjazz notes
  if key.state == "released" then
    if name and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
      plsb_note_off(name)
      return nil
    end
    return key
  end

  -- navigation + actions (not key-repeat sensitive except arrows)
  if name == "esc" then
    PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Close(true)
    return nil
  elseif name == "rshift" then
    -- Right-Shift = load into a NEW instrument, close, Edit Mode + Follow Pattern on,
    -- and jump to the Pattern Editor ready to jam
    if not key.repeated then PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_ConfirmJam() end
    return nil
  elseif name == "return" then
    if not key.repeated then
      local e = S.entries[S.selected]
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift", 1, true) and e and e.kind == "dir" then
        plsb_defer_action(plsb_load_folder_now)
      else
        plsb_activate_entry()
      end
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "up" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Up jumps to the top
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(1) else plsb_move(-1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "down" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Down jumps to the bottom
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(#S.entries) else plsb_move(1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "prior" then       -- Page Up
    plsb_move(-VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "next" then        -- Page Down
    plsb_move(VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "left" or name == "back" then
    plsb_go_up()
    return nil
  elseif name == "right" then
    local e = S.entries[S.selected]
    if e and e.kind == "updir" then
      plsb_go_up()
    elseif e and e.kind == "dir" then
      plsb_enter_dir(e.path)
      plsb_refresh()
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "<" or name == "less" then
    plsb_shift_octave(-1); return nil
  elseif name == ">" or name == "greater" then
    plsb_shift_octave(1); return nil
  end

  -- F1-F12 folder presets: Fn recalls, Shift+Fn stores the current folder
  local fn = name and name:match("^f(%d+)$")
  if fn then
    local n = tonumber(fn)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 12 then
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift") then
        plsb_set_preset(n, S.current_dir)
        renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: stored folder preset F" .. n .. " = " .. (S.current_dir or ""))
      else
        local presets = plsb_get_presets()
        local p = presets[n]
        if p and p ~= "" and io.exists(p) then
          plsb_enter_dir(p)
          plsb_refresh()
        else
          renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: folder preset F" .. n .. " is empty (Shift+F" .. n .. " to store current folder)")
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
  end

  -- Modified piano keys belong to Renoise's global shortcuts.
  if (not key.modifiers or key.modifiers == "") and name
    and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
    if not key.repeated then plsb_note_on(name) end
    return nil
  end

  -- Octave controls and the opening shortcut must reach Renoise. Confirmation
  -- queues a timer, so forwarding does not destroy this window during dispatch.
  return key
end

local function plsb_adjust_scroll()
  if S.selected < S.scroll + 1 then S.scroll = S.selected - 1 end
  if S.selected > S.scroll + VISIBLE_ROWS then S.scroll = S.selected - VISIBLE_ROWS end
  if S.scroll < 0 then S.scroll = 0 end
end

local function plsb_rebuild_entries(select_name)
  S.entries = {}
  local dir = S.current_dir

  -- synthetic "all drives" level (Windows): list each mounted drive, no up-dir
  if dir == PLSB_DRIVE_ROOT then
    for _, d in ipairs(plsb_list_drives()) do
      S.entries[#S.entries + 1] = { kind = "dir", name = d.label, path = d.path }
    end
  else
    -- the find filter (nil = show everything). Folders are only filtered when the
    -- query is active, so you can still navigate; the updir "." always stays.
    local filt = plsb_find_parse(S.find_query)

local function plsb_meta_string()
  local m = S.meta
  local e = S.entries[S.selected]
  local oct = (renoise.song() and renoise.song().transport.octave) or 0
  if not e then return "No file selected\n\nKeyjazz octave: " .. oct end
  if e.kind ~= "file" then
    return (e.kind == "updir" and ".. (parent folder)" or ("Folder: " .. e.name))
      .. "\n\nEnter to open\n\nKeyjazz octave: " .. oct
  end
  local lines = {}
  lines[#lines + 1] = "Filename:    " .. (m.name or "-")
  lines[#lines + 1] = "Format:      " .. (m.format or "-")
  if S.preview_ok then
    lines[#lines + 1] = "Sample rate: " .. tostring(m.sample_rate or 0) .. " Hz"
    lines[#lines + 1] = "Quality:     " .. tostring(m.bit_depth or 0) .. " bit "
      .. ((m.channels == 2) and "Stereo" or "Mono")
    lines[#lines + 1] = "Length:      " .. tostring(m.frames or 0) .. " frames"
    lines[#lines + 1] = "Loop:        " .. (m.loop_mode or "Off")

    if S.sel_range then

      local b = math.max(S.sel_range[1], S.sel_range[2])

    end

  end
  if m.size then lines[#lines + 1] = "Size:        " .. tostring(m.size) .. " bytes" end
  if m.date then lines[#lines + 1] = "Date:        " .. m.date .. (m.time and ("  " .. m.time) or "") end
  lines[#lines + 1] = ""
  lines[#lines + 1] = "Keyjazz octave: " .. oct

local function plsb_key_handler(dialog, key)
  if S.pending_action then return nil end
  local name = key.name

  -- key releases: stop keyjazz notes
  if key.state == "released" then
    if name and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
      plsb_note_off(name)
      return nil
    end
    return key
  end

  -- navigation + actions (not key-repeat sensitive except arrows)
  if name == "esc" then
    PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Close(true)
    return nil
  elseif name == "rshift" then
    -- Right-Shift = load into a NEW instrument, close, Edit Mode + Follow Pattern on,
    -- and jump to the Pattern Editor ready to jam
    if not key.repeated then PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_ConfirmJam() end
    return nil
  elseif name == "return" then
    if not key.repeated then
      local e = S.entries[S.selected]
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift", 1, true) and e and e.kind == "dir" then
        plsb_defer_action(plsb_load_folder_now)
      else
        plsb_activate_entry()
      end
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "up" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Up jumps to the top
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(1) else plsb_move(-1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "down" then
    -- any modifier (Cmd / Option / Shift / Ctrl) + Down jumps to the bottom
    local jump = key.modifiers and key.modifiers ~= ""
    if jump then plsb_move_to(#S.entries) else plsb_move(1) end
    return nil
  elseif name == "prior" then       -- Page Up
    plsb_move(-VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "next" then        -- Page Down
    plsb_move(VISIBLE_ROWS); return nil
  elseif name == "left" or name == "back" then
    plsb_go_up()
    return nil
  elseif name == "right" then
    local e = S.entries[S.selected]
    if e and e.kind == "updir" then
      plsb_go_up()
    elseif e and e.kind == "dir" then
      plsb_enter_dir(e.path)
      plsb_refresh()
    end
    return nil
  elseif name == "<" or name == "less" then
    plsb_shift_octave(-1); return nil
  elseif name == ">" or name == "greater" then
    plsb_shift_octave(1); return nil
  end

  -- F1-F12 folder presets: Fn recalls, Shift+Fn stores the current folder
  local fn = name and name:match("^f(%d+)$")
  if fn then
    local n = tonumber(fn)
    if n and n >= 1 and n <= 12 then
      if key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift") then
        plsb_set_preset(n, S.current_dir)
        renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: stored folder preset F" .. n .. " = " .. (S.current_dir or ""))
      else
        local presets = plsb_get_presets()
        local p = presets[n]
        if p and p ~= "" and io.exists(p) then
          plsb_enter_dir(p)
          plsb_refresh()
        else
          renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: folder preset F" .. n .. " is empty (Shift+F" .. n .. " to store current folder)")
        end
      end
      return nil
    end
  end

  -- Modified piano keys belong to Renoise's global shortcuts.
  if (not key.modifiers or key.modifiers == "") and name
    and (PLSB_LOWER[name] ~= nil or PLSB_UPPER[name] ~= nil) then
    if not key.repeated then plsb_note_on(name) end
    return nil
  end

  -- Octave controls and the opening shortcut must reach Renoise. Confirmation
  -- queues a timer, so forwarding does not destroy this window during dispatch.
  return key
end

function PakettiLoadSampleBrowser_Open()
  if S.pending_action then return end
  if not renoise.song() then
    renoise.app():show_status("Paketti Load Sample: no song")
    return
  end
  if S.dialog and S.dialog.visible then
    S.dialog:show()
    return
  end
  plsb_cleanup_scratch()
  S.active_notes = {}
  S.find_query = ""
  local content = vb:column {
    margin = 6,
    spacing = 6,
    vb:row {
      spacing = 6,
      vb:button {
        text = "Open Folder…",
        width = 110,
        notifier = function()
          -- native folder picker -> reaches any folder/drive (C:/D:/E:, network, etc.)
          local ok, path = pcall(function()
            return renoise.app():prompt_for_path("Load Sample Browser: choose a folder")
          end)
          if ok and path and path ~= "" and io.exists(path) then
            plsb_enter_dir(path)
            plsb_refresh()
          end
        end,
      },
      vb:text{ id = S.dir_id, font = "mono", style = "strong", text = "", width = LIST_CANVAS_W - 116 },
    },
    -- Find: filters the file/folder list. kick 909 (both) · kick or snare · -loop · "tr 909" · kick*.wav
    vb:row {
      spacing = 6,
      vb:text{ text = "Find", font = "bold", width = 34 },
      vb:textfield{
        id = S.find_id,
        width = LIST_CANVAS_W - 34 - 70 - 12,
        text = S.find_query or "",
        notifier = function(txt)
          -- ViewBuilder fires this once while the dialog is being built; ignore the
          -- no-op so we don't rebuild entries before the dialog exists.
          txt = txt or ""
          if txt == (S.find_query or "") then return end
          S.find_query = txt
          plsb_rebuild_entries()
          plsb_refresh()
        end,
      },
      vb:button{
        text = "Clear",
        width = 70,
        notifier = function()
          S.find_query = ""
          if S.vb and S.vb.views[S.find_id] then S.vb.views[S.find_id].text = "" end
          plsb_rebuild_entries()
          plsb_refresh()
        end,
      },
    },
    vb:row {
      spacing = 10,
      -- the file list is a canvas so the selected row is a full inverted bar
      vb:canvas{
        id = S.list_id,
        width = LIST_CANVAS_W,
        height = LIST_CANVAS_H,
        mode = "plain",
        render = plsb_list_render,
        mouse_handler = plsb_list_mouse,
        mouse_events = { "down" },
      },
      vb:column {
        spacing = 6,
        -- the metadata panel is ordinary, human-readable Renoise text
        vb:multiline_text{ id = S.meta_id, font = "mono", text = "", width = META_W, height = META_H },
        vb:text{ text = "Waveform  (click = play from point · drag = select · drag flags = loop)", font = "bold" },
        -- interactive: click plays from the point, drag selects, drag the loop flags to move the loop
        vb:canvas{
          id = S.wave_id, width = WAVE_W, height = WAVE_H, mode = "plain",
          render = plsb_wave_render,
          mouse_handler = plsb_wave_mouse,
          mouse_events = { "down", "up", "move", "drag" },
        },
        vb:row {
          spacing = 6,
          vb:button{ id = S.loopbtn_id, text = "Loop: Off", width = 110,
            notifier = function() plsb_cycle_loop_mode(1) end },
          vb:button{ text = "Loop → Selection", width = 130,
            notifier = function() plsb_loop_to_selection() end },
          vb:button{ text = "Clear Sel", width = 80,
            notifier = function() plsb_clear_selection() end },
        },
      },
    },
  }

  plsb_rebuild_entries()

  -- restore the last highlighted file (by name, so it survives files being added/removed)
  local want = (preferences and preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastFile
    and preferences.pakettiLoadSampleBrowserLastFile.value) or ""
  if want ~= "" then
    for i, e in ipairs(S.entries) do
      if e.name == want then S.selected = i break end
    end
    plsb_adjust_scroll()
    plsb_preview_selected()
  end

  local key_opts = { send_key_repeat = true, send_key_release = true }
  S.dialog = renoise.app():show_custom_dialog("Paketti Load Sample (Keyjazz Preview)",
    content, plsb_key_handler, key_opts)

    -- the find filter (nil = show everything). Folders are only filtered when the

    local filt = plsb_find_parse(S.find_query)

    local parent = plsb_parent(dir)
    if parent ~= dir then
      S.entries[#S.entries + 1] = { kind = "updir", name = "..", path = parent }
    end
    -- directories
    local ok_dirs, dirs = pcall(function() return os.dirnames(dir) end)
    if ok_dirs and dirs then
      table.sort(dirs, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
      for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
        if not filt or plsb_find_match(filt, d) then
          S.entries[#S.entries + 1] = { kind = "dir", name = d, path = plsb_join(dir, d) }
        end
      end
    end
    -- files (loadable extensions)
    local patterns = { "*" }
    local ok_pat, p = pcall(function() return PakettiLoadableExtensions() end)
    if ok_pat and p then patterns = p end

    if ok_files and files then
      table.sort(files, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
      for _, f in ipairs(files) do
        if not filt or plsb_find_match(filt, f) then
          S.entries[#S.entries + 1] = { kind = "file", name = f, path = plsb_join(dir, f) }

end

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('PLAN.md');p.write_text(p.read_text()+'\n- [~] Keep angle-key octave changes working with Caps Lock {#sample-preview-caps-octave}\n  by: codex\n  from: agent\n')
p=Path('PakettiLoadSampleBrowser.lua');s=p.read_text();anchor='local function plsb_key_handler(dialog, key)';helper='''-- REPORT-CARD >> features/sample-browser-editing.feature
local function plsb_octave_key_delta(key)
  -- Prefer the typed symbol; Caps Lock is irrelevant to these punctuation keys.
  if key.character == ">" then return 1 end
  if key.character == "<" then return -1 end
  local name = key.name and key.name:lower()
  if name == ">" or name == "greater" then return 1 end
  if name == "<" or name == "less" then
    return key.modifiers and key.modifiers:find("shift", 1, true) and 1 or -1
  end
end

''';s=s.replace(anchor,helper+anchor,1);s=s.replace('  -- navigation + actions (not key-repeat sensitive except arrows)','''  local octave_delta = plsb_octave_key_delta(key)
  if octave_delta then plsb_shift_octave(octave_delta); return nil end

  -- navigation + actions (not key-repeat sensitive except arrows)''',1);s=s.replace('  elseif name == "<" or name == "less" then\n    plsb_shift_octave(-1); return nil\n  elseif name == ">" or name == "greater" then\n    plsb_shift_octave(1); return nil\n','');p.write_text(s)
p=Path('tests/sample-browser-editing.lua');s=p.read_text();s+='''
local octave=assert(source:match('(local function plsb_octave_key_delta%(key%).-)\\nlocal function plsb_key_handler'))
local delta=assert(load(octave..'\\nreturn plsb_octave_key_delta'))()
for _,mods in ipairs({'','capslock','caps','shift','shift,capslock','shift,caps'}) do
 assert(delta({name='less',character='<',modifiers=mods})==-1)
 assert(delta({name='less',character='>',modifiers=mods})==1)
 assert(delta({name='greater',modifiers=mods})==1)
 assert(delta({name='less',modifiers=mods})==(mods:find('shift',1,true) and 1 or -1))
end
assert(delta({name='a',modifiers='capslock'})==nil)
print('sample-browser-caps-octave: passed')
''';p.write_text(s)
PY
lua tests/sample-browser-editing.lua
luac -p PakettiLoadSampleBrowser.lua","max_output_tokens":300}));

local KIT_DRUM, KIT_DIST, KIT_LAYERS = 1, 2, 3
local OVERLAP_ITEMS = { "Play All", "Cycle", "Random" }  -- Overlap: 0, 1, 2
C.WHITE_KEY = { [0] = true, [2] = true, [4] = true, [5] = true,
                    [7] = true, [9] = true, [11] = true }

-- the sample editor draws waveforms in the theme's "Main Font" colour, so
-- the preview uses that theme slot and follows whatever theme is loaded
C.WAVE_COLOR = "main_font"
C.WAVE_FALLBACK = { 228, 228, 228 }

C.AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = {
  wav = true, aif = true, aiff = true, flac = true, mp3 = true, ogg = true,
}

C.NOTE_NAMES = { "C-", "C#", "D-", "D#", "E-", "F-",
                     "F#", "G-", "G#", "A-", "A#", "B-" }

local IS_WINDOWS = (os.platform() == "WINDOWS")
local SEP = IS_WINDOWS and "\\" or "/"


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Preferences
-- (the document name is the first version's, so settings carry over)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local prefs = renoise.Document.create("SampleBrowserPreferences") {
  prefs_version     = 0,
  root_folder       = "",
  save_root         = false,  -- no longer used: the root is always kept
  remember_location = true,   -- reopen where we last were
  last_path         = "",
  autoplay          = true,   -- preview when the highlight moves onto a file
  show_contents     = true,   -- two panes (folders | samples)
  show_kit          = false,  -- Multi-Sample panel visible
  default_loop      = 1,      -- loop of a sample without one: Off
  file_loops        = true,   -- use the loop a file carries
  default_interp    = 3,      -- Interpolation of every sample played and loaded
  kit_mode          = KIT_DRUM,
  kit_start         = 48,     -- first note of a drumkit (C-4)
  kit_default_open  = false,  -- open the Multi-Sample panel with the browser
  sync_tempo        = false,  -- Beatsync looping samples to the song tempo
  white_keys        = false,  -- drumkit: white keys only
  overlap           = 1,      -- layer: index into OVERLAP_ITEMS
  include_subfolders = true,  -- samples pane lists sub folders' samples too
  find_root         = true,   -- find searches the whole root
  prehear_volume    = 0.9,
  prehear_master    = true,   -- prehear on the master track (Renoise default)
  sync_mode         = 2,      -- Beatsync mode: Repitch / Percussion / Texture
  insert_advance    = false,  -- 'Insert' moves to the next sample afterwards
  hidden_paths      = "",     -- items hidden from the browser, one per line
  places            = "",     -- extra folders next to the root, one per line
  snap_zero         = true,   -- loop points snap to zero crossings
  kit_keyjazz       = false,  -- piano keys play the Multi-Sample everywhere
  bookmark_1 = "", bookmark_2 = "", bookmark_3 = "", bookmark_4 = "",
  bookmark_5 = "", bookmark_6 = "", bookmark_7 = "", bookmark_8 = "",
  -- no longer used; kept so settings files of earlier versions still load
  add_octave = false, loop_mode = 5, wave_color = 1, show_help = false,
  show_info = true,
}
renoise.tool().preferences = prefs

-- settings of earlier versions:
-- the Multi-Sample modes became Drumkit / Distribute / Layer (Layer 2 -> 3)
if prefs.prefs_version.value < 5 then
  if prefs.kit_mode.value == 2 then prefs.kit_mode.value = KIT_LAYERS end
  prefs.prefs_version.value = 5
end

-- the samples pane became the default
if prefs.prefs_version.value < 6 then
  prefs.show_contents.value = true
  prefs.prefs_version.value = 6
end

-- find searches the whole folder path by default
if prefs.prefs_version.value < 7 then
  prefs.find_root.value = true
  prefs.prefs_version.value = 7
end

-- the root stays the root until you set another one (save_root is no
-- longer used)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- State
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- A panel: entries + highlighted index + first visible row.
--   folder   entries: { name=, is_dir=, up= }
--   contents entries: { name=, rel=, full=, is_dir=false }
--   kit      entries: { name=, full=, is_dir=false }
